author: TehPotatoCat
body:
My Minecraft Username is TehPotatoCat

I got Banned Because of flying and I believe this is a mistake. Even if someone says its not than I'm sorry and it wil never happen again.

This is the first appeal i have made and i have been playing this server for 2 or so years.

I should be unbanned because i believe this is a mistake and i had and loved this server for a long time and still do.

I have never evaded a ban and this is a perm ban, i have no evidence to show the staff and i take this post and this server very seriously and i hope you read this a make a decision.


Thank You.

GOD BLESS
